clips.title: The story
paras: Skywall is the vast, storm-swept domain of the air elementals within the Elemental Plane. Banished here by the titans in ancient days, the creatures of wind, cloud, and lightning dwell under the reign of Al'Akir the Windlord.

When the titans overthrew the Old Gods eons ago, they crafted the Elemental Plane as a secure dimensional prison to contain Azeroth's unruly elemental spirits. The lords of the elements fought fiercely amongst themselves, ultimately carving out distinct dominions. The realm of wind and storm became known as Skywall, ruled by Al'Akir the Windlord. While sealed away from the surface world, its tempests continue to swirl in eternal isolation.
